newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil ends up, trade cautious.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil ends up, trade cautious.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed slightly higher on a technical adjustment to Monday's fall, and an Indian tender. Uncertainty over the results of the Indian tender also limited activity. Morning sentiment was uncertain with falls in the Chicago soyoil futures easing prices.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - The market was cautious with players still concerned over PORLA crop data released on Monday.
Dealing was cautious as players were still concerned over the bearish crop data for August, released by the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) on Monday.
"People are watching closely the market direction before making further commitmments," the trader said.
"The end-August stocks were high and production was also on the high side," another trader said, adding that players were still digesting the PORLA figures.
"Some recovery was seen this morning after the market fell a lot yesterday on the PORLA data," a dealer said.
Third month December futures contract was up three ringgit at 1,161 ringgit ($465.14) a tonne after opening at 1,149.
Dealers said the next support level for the contract is 1,140 ringgit with resistance at 1,170.
Dealing slowed down and volume on the futures market was 1,532 lots against 4,321 lots on Monday.

Physicals Sep (south) crude palm oil was quoted sellers at 1,190 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,180 to 1,195. Sep (south) saw bids at 1,180. Sep (central) was offered at 1,160 with bids at 1,155. Sep (north) saw bids at 1,150 with no offers quoted.
Oct (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,190 ringgit with bids at 1,180. Oct (central) saw offers at 1,170 and bids at 1,155 and Nov (south) at 1,190 with bids at 1,185.
In refined products, Sep RBD palmoil was offered at $512.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $507.50.
Sep palm olein saw offers at $550, Oct at $545 and Nov/Dec at $532.50. Nov/Dec was dealt at $530 and Nov at $532.50.
Sep RBD palm stearin was offered at $402.50 and Oct at $405. Sep/Oct/Nov palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $337.50. -- Tan Lee Lee (603-2308911) ($1=2.4960 ringgit)
